## What this region is

The brand theme shipped as CSS from @inixiative/config: the base tokens and fonts, the agent-work status layer, the four nestable domain palettes and the marketing grammar, plus the rules for loading and reading them.

## What it exists for

- Pick which theme CSS file to load for a page
- Wire the theme CSS so colours and dark mode come out right

## How people say these problems

A moment that says any of these, or something close, is this region's. Both voices: the user asking or correcting, and the agent describing what it is about to build.

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- a retired product name is still in the landing page copy → retired-terms
- bump @inixiative/config in the app to get the new palette → version-coherence
- add the react lint rules for the component library → toolchain-presets
- which local port the marketing site's web server runs on → port-registry
